title: Session 2: Search Engine Optimization and Its Components

questions.questionText: Search Engine Optimization (SEO) refers to the process of:
options: Increasing the visibility of web pages and ranking them higher
questions.correctAnswer: Increasing the visibility of web pages and ranking them higher
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Increasing the visibility of web pages and ranking them higher.

questions.questionText: Page rank refers to:
options: The position of a website in SERPs
The number of pages in a site
questions.correctAnswer: The position of a website in SERPs
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) The position of a website in SERPs.

questions.questionText: In the late 1990s, SEO was mostly done using:
questions.correctAnswer: On-page activities
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) On-page activities.

questions.questionText: In the year 2000, Google introduced which algorithm?
questions.correctAnswer: PageRank
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) PageRank.

questions.questionText: Organic traffic refers to visitors who land on a website from:
options: Unpaid sources such as search engines
questions.correctAnswer: Unpaid sources such as search engines
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Unpaid sources such as search engines.

questions.questionText: SEO helps increase which two aspects of website traffic?
questions.correctAnswer: Quantity and quality
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Quantity and quality.

questions.questionText: What are the basic techniques of SEO listed in the guide?
options: Keyword research, technical SEO, on-page SEO and link building
questions.correctAnswer: Keyword research, technical SEO, on-page SEO and link building
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Keyword research, technical SEO, on-page SEO and link building.

questions.questionText: Google's tool that estimates searches for keywords and helps find new keywords is:
questions.correctAnswer: Keyword Planner
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Keyword Planner.

questions.questionText: Technical SEO is the process of:
options: Optimizing a website's technical elements so that search engines can crawl and index it
questions.correctAnswer: Optimizing a website's technical elements so that search engines can crawl and index it
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Optimizing a website's technical elements so that search engines can crawl and index it.

questions.questionText:
Which free Google tool helps monitor, maintain and troubleshoot a site's presence in Google
 Search?
questions.correctAnswer: Google Search Console
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Google Search Console.

questions.questionText: The robots.txt file informs the search engine crawler about:
questions.correctAnswer: The URLs it can access
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) The URLs it can access.

questions.questionText: A sitemap is a file that:
options: Provides information about pages and media files
questions.correctAnswer: Provides information about pages and media files
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Provides information about pages and media files.

questions.questionText: On-page SEO refers to:
options: Optimizing individual web pages with quality content and HTML source code
questions.correctAnswer: Optimizing individual web pages with quality content and HTML source code
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Optimizing individual web pages with quality content and HTML source code.

questions.questionText: Which SEO-friendly URL practice is recommended?
options: Use lower-case letters and keep URLs short
Use capital letters and long URLs
questions.correctAnswer: Use lower-case letters and keep URLs short
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Use lower-case letters and keep URLs short.

questions.questionText: Titles of pages should be:
questions.correctAnswer: Short, informative and unique
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Short, informative and unique.

questions.questionText: Too many heading tags on a webpage:
options: Make it hard for users to determine where content starts and ends
questions.correctAnswer: Make it hard for users to determine where content starts and ends
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Make it hard for users to determine where content starts and ends.

questions.questionText: Backlinking is:
options: Getting links from other websites to your own site
Linking to your own pages only
questions.correctAnswer: Getting links from other websites to your own site
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Getting links from other websites to your own site.

questions.questionText: Backlinks should be built from:
questions.correctAnswer: Trustworthy sources
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Trustworthy sources.

questions.questionText: Black hat SEO practices are those that:
questions.correctAnswer: Go against search engine guidelines
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Go against search engine guidelines.

questions.questionText: Which is a black hat technique?
options: Cloaking: showing different content to users and search engines
questions.correctAnswer: Cloaking: showing different content to users and search engines
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Cloaking: showing different content to users and search engines.

questions.questionText: Copying content from a different website and publishing it on one's own site is called:
questions.correctAnswer: Content duplication
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Content duplication.

questions.questionText: Overusing keywords in a page is called:
questions.correctAnswer: Keyword stuffing
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Keyword stuffing.

questions.questionText: White hat SEO practices:
questions.correctAnswer: Follow search engine guidelines
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Follow search engine guidelines.

questions.questionText: A feature of white hat content is:
options: A structured website with proper internal links
questions.correctAnswer: A structured website with proper internal links
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) A structured website with proper internal links.

questions.questionText: Gray hat SEO refers to practices that:
questions.correctAnswer: Do not have well-defined guidelines
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Do not have well-defined guidelines.

questions.questionText: Which is an example of a gray hat practice?
questions.correctAnswer: Link generation using microsites
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Link generation using microsites.

questions.questionText: Buying Facebook likes is considered:
questions.correctAnswer: Gray hat SEO
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Gray hat SEO.

questions.questionText: If content gets retweets and social shares organically, it becomes:
questions.correctAnswer: White hat SEO
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) White hat SEO.

questions.questionText: Why should old blog posts be updated with new content?
options: They already bring traffic and updating them with keywords engages visitors more
questions.correctAnswer: They already bring traffic and updating them with keywords engages visitors more
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) They already bring traffic and updating them with keywords engages visitors more.

questions.questionText: Google Search Console was earlier called:
questions.correctAnswer: Google Webmaster Tools
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Google Webmaster Tools.

questions.questionText: Which of the following can Search Console show?
options: How often the site appears in Google Search
questions.correctAnswer: How often the site appears in Google Search
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) How often the site appears in Google Search.

questions.questionText: To set up Search Console, the first step is to:
options: Sign in with a Google account
questions.correctAnswer: Sign in with a Google account
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Sign in with a Google account.

questions.questionText: Why is site ownership verified in Search Console?
options: So only verified owners can access sensitive search data
questions.correctAnswer: So only verified owners can access sensitive search data
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) So only verified owners can access sensitive search data.

questions.questionText: A "Domain" property in Search Console connects to:
options: Every aspect of the site, including all subdomains
questions.correctAnswer: Every aspect of the site, including all subdomains
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Every aspect of the site, including all subdomains.

questions.questionText: A domain property can only be verified via:
questions.correctAnswer: DNS record
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) DNS record.

questions.questionText: A "URL-prefix" property applies to:
options: Only a single URL prefix of the site
questions.correctAnswer: Only a single URL prefix of the site
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Only a single URL prefix of the site.

questions.questionText: Submitting a sitemap is recommended especially when:
options: The site has a large number of URLs
questions.correctAnswer: The site has a large number of URLs
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) The site has a large number of URLs.

questions.questionText: The Search Console tool that can test whether a page can be indexed and request recrawl is:
questions.correctAnswer: URL Inspection tool
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) URL Inspection tool.

questions.questionText: If the URL Inspection live test finds no indexing issues, the page is:
questions.correctAnswer: Queued for indexing
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Queued for indexing.

questions.questionText: Grouping Performance report data by "queries" displays:
options: Metrics for keywords, such as clicks and impressions
questions.correctAnswer: Metrics for keywords, such as clicks and impressions
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Metrics for keywords, such as clicks and impressions.

questions.questionText: The Sitemaps report is used to:
options: Inform Google about new sitemaps and view errors
questions.correctAnswer: Inform Google about new sitemaps and view errors
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Inform Google about new sitemaps and view errors.

questions.questionText: Page experience is a set of signals that measure:
options: How users experience interacting with a page beyond content
questions.correctAnswer: How users experience interacting with a page beyond content
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) How users experience interacting with a page beyond content.

questions.questionText: Page experience is currently evaluated only on:
questions.correctAnswer: Mobile devices
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Mobile devices.

questions.questionText: Google's general guideline says images should have:
questions.correctAnswer: An alt attribute
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) An alt attribute.

questions.questionText: Which tool can be used to test page performance?
questions.correctAnswer: PageSpeed Insights
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) PageSpeed Insights.

questions.questionText: Which is a quality content guideline?
options: Create content only for search engines
Create content for users and not for search engines
questions.correctAnswer: Create content for users and not for search engines
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Create content for users and not for search engines.

questions.questionText: Why should a site be secured with HTTPS?
options: It hides the site from Google
Security is a ranking signal and protects data confidentiality
questions.correctAnswer: Security is a ranking signal and protects data confidentiality
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Security is a ranking signal and protects data confidentiality.

questions.questionText: Structured data is:
options: A standardized format to mark up information on a web page
questions.correctAnswer: A standardized format to mark up information on a web page
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) A standardized format to mark up information on a web page.

questions.questionText: An XML sitemap is:
options: A list of URLs of a website that informs search engines about content
questions.correctAnswer: A list of URLs of a website that informs search engines about content
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) A list of URLs of a website that informs search engines about content.

questions.questionText: Which attribute helps a site target different countries and avoids duplicate content problems?
questions.correctAnswer: hreflang
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) hreflang.

questions.questionText: Off-page SEO refers to:
options: SEO strategies implemented outside the website to increase its authority
questions.correctAnswer: SEO strategies implemented outside the website to increase its authority
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) SEO strategies implemented outside the website to increase its authority.

questions.questionText: Which is a common off-page SEO strategy?
questions.correctAnswer: Link building
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Link building.

questions.questionText: In influencer marketing, a brand:
options: Collaborates with an online influencer to market its products
questions.correctAnswer: Collaborates with an online influencer to market its products
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Collaborates with an online influencer to market its products.

questions.questionText: Publishing podcasts is an example of:
options: An off-page strategy using audio content
questions.correctAnswer: An off-page strategy using audio content
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) An off-page strategy using audio content.
